title: Wow Thats Alot Of Mods
description: WTAOM is a modpack brimming with tech, magic, and adventure, 300+ mods.
body: WTAOM is a modpack brimming with tech, magic, and adventure. Grow wings and fly with the couds using Icarus, Cast spells with Ars Nouveau, Fight bosses with Cataclysm, Make crazy mechanisms with Create, and many more. This modpack is made to test your limits and see how much you can make in your world or server, Have Fun! _WTAOM_ _Wuh-Tay-Uhm_
